# Final preprocessing

Since there are several independent batches of samples with partially very different outcomes in terms of processing quality and cell viability we will use data set integration using Harmony.


```{r}
rerun = F
if(rerun) {
  set.seed(20230808)
  scData = all_ge_data_filtered
  rm(all_ge_data_filtered)
  scData <- NormalizeData(object = scData, normalization.method = "LogNormalize", scale.factor = 1e4)
  scData <- FindVariableFeatures(object = scData, selection.method = "vst")
  scData <- ScaleData(object = scData)
  scData <- RunPCA(scData, npcs = 50)
  scData <- RunHarmony(scData, 
                       group.by.vars = "orig.ident", 
                       dims.use = 1:30)
  scData <- RunUMAP(scData, reduction = "harmony", dims = 1:20)
  scData <- FindNeighbors(scData, reduction = "harmony", dims = 1:20)
  scData <- FindClusters(scData, resolution = 0.5)
  scData.combined <- scData
}
```


```{r}
filename <- file.path(data_storage_folder, "Yue_IMO_Harmony.rds")
if(rerun) {
  saveRDS(scData.combined, file=filename, compress = T)  
} else {
  scData.combined <- readRDS(filename)
}

```

# Global clusters

```{r, fig.width=14}
DimPlot(scData.combined, reduction = "umap", group.by = "orig.ident")

p1 <- DimPlot(scData.combined, reduction = "umap", group.by = "Condition")
p2 <- DimPlot(scData.combined, reduction = "umap", label = TRUE)
plot_grid(p1, p2)

DimPlot(scData.combined, reduction = "umap", split.by = "Condition", label = T)
```

## Cluster assignments

```{r, fig.height=10}
m = table(scData.combined@meta.data$seurat_clusters, scData.combined@meta.data$sample_label)
kable(m)

mm = as.matrix.data.frame(m)
colnames(mm) = colnames(m)
rownames(mm) = rownames(m)
mm_rel = sweep(mm, 2, apply(mm, 2,sum), "/")
pheatmap(mm_rel, main="Relative single cell contribution of each cluster to condition totals")
```
